text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even though I decided I'd catch up to 
Prez. And yet... and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I can't even call myself 
Teio-sama...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: It's not like everything is over yet.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. My path hasn't 
come to an end."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll start over from here once again.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Trainer, train me even harder. 
So that I won't lose... to anyone ever 
again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: Lady Teio said she'll never lose again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not going to lose anymore. I won't 
let anyone run ahead of me ever again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna prove that I'm truly invincible!
